title: Cell-scale contractile construct in PhysiCell 1.14.2: when can prescribed contraction translate a cell sheet?
frozen_note: written after one 90-min smoke run of arm A1 (pair, anisotropic, dt 0.1) used to check the build; that smoke run is NOT part of the results and its numbers are not reused
scope_statement: Overdamped cell-centre mechanics with a prescribed contraction law. The contraction is THIS PROJECT'S MODELLING CHOICE: the cited CDO sources (Kriegman 2020, Blackiston 2021, abstract level) report CILIARY locomotion. No parameter here is measured from Xenopus or any tissue. Time units are nominal: only k*T and the drag ratio matter in an overdamped model. Nothing here is an observation.

engine.name: PhysiCell
engine.licence: BSD-3-Clause, licenses/PhysiCell.txt (plus BioFVM, MaBoSS, pugixml licence files)

model.mechanics: PhysiCell overdamped update: velocity = summed force (unit mobility), Adams-Bashforth-2 position update (core/PhysiCell_cell.cpp Cell::update_position).
model.springs_mode: neighbour springs within 1.1 r0 at setup, force k(|d| - L_ij(t)) d/|d|, L_ij(t) = r0 (1 - eps (1 - cos(w t - dir q xbar_ij))/2). PhysiCell repulsion/adhesion zeroed.
model.native_mode: no custom springs; PhysiCell repulsion+adhesion potentials; prescribed radius R_i(t) = R0 (1 - eps (1 - cos(w t - dir q x_i0))/2).
model.substrate_drag: x-velocity divided by xi_p if >= 0 and by xi_m if < 0 (direction-dependent drag); xi_p = xi_m = 1 is stock PhysiCell.

defaults.strip: NX=10, NY=3 centred hex strip, 29 cells, mirror-symmetric about x=0

theory_links.B_linear_drag: drag_weighted_centroid_fixed / linear_drag_no_net_displacement: with xi_p = xi_m the centroid cannot move at all, for any actuation, phase gradient or body shape
theory_links.C_crawler: crawler_path: pair displacement = kappa * TV(L), kappa = (xi_m - xi_p)/(2 (xi_p + xi_m)); crawler_mirror; crawler_zero_iff_isotropic

arms.prediction: |dX| <= 1e-9 um: a phase gradient alone does not translate the body under linear drag (theorem B)

arms.params: native potentials, strip, eps=0.1, xi=(1,1), travelling +x
arms.prediction: |dX| <= 1e-6 um IF PhysiCell's own potentials are pairwise antisymmetric. A larger drift is reported as a finding about the engine, not tuned away.

arms.params: native potentials, strip, eps=0.1, xi=(1,3), travelling +x

arms.prediction: dX > 0 and |dX / (kappa*TV(L)) - 1| <= 0.01 at every dt, with |ratio-1| non-increasing as dt halves (kappa=0.25)

arms.params: strip, eps=0.1, xi=(1,3), standing, dt in {0.1,0.05}
strip, eps=0.1, xi=(1,3), travelling +x, dt in {0.1,0.05}
strip, eps=0.1, xi=(1,3), travelling -x, dt in {0.1,0.05}
strip, eps=0.1, xi=(3,1), travelling -x (mirror image of A4)

preregistered_endpoints_mapping.passive-control: P0-pair and P0-strip. If either fails, no other arm may be read until diagnosed.
preregistered_endpoints_mapping.pattern-dependence: A3 (standing) vs A4 (travelling +x) and A4 vs A5, equal total actuation (same eps, same springs, same cycle-mean rest-length reduction eps/2 per spring). PASS only if |dX(A4)-dX(A3)| and |dX(A4)-dX(A5)| each exceed max(|dX(dt=0.1)-dX(dt=0.05)|) over the two arms compared. If not, no pattern-to-motion statement is made.
preregistered_endpoints_mapping.mirror-symmetry: A2 vs A1 (pair) and A6 vs A4 (strip).

falsifiers: Any isotropic-drag arm (I1, I2, I3) with |dX| > 1e-9 um falsifies the claim that the module implements theorem B's hypotheses (or exposes a non-antisymmetric force in the code).
A1 ratio outside [0.99, 1.01] at dt=0.025 falsifies the pathwise crawler law as implemented here.
A failed mirror endpoint marks an anisotropy artifact in body construction or solver.
what_this_cannot_establish: that any tissue contracts in this way, at this amplitude or period
that a real substrate has direction-dependent drag, or what its ratio would be
anything about ciliary propulsion, which is what the sources report
Xenopus-scale or microcarrier-scale displacement in physical units
